title: PCR Prep with 1.5 mL Tubes Part 1 - Plate Filling
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Select plates and reagent
steps.instruction: Decide how many plates to fill and whether to use reaction buffer or mastermix; note that 80 µL per well will be transferred for buffer and 7.6 µL per well for mastermix.

steps.title: Mount pipettes
steps.instruction: Mount the P300 Multi‑Channel pipette on the side (left or right) specified for buffer and mount the P20 Single‑Channel pipette on the side (left or right) specified for mastermix.

steps.title: Load labware
steps.instruction: Place the required number of plates on the deck, load a reagent reservoir with the chosen reagent, and keep plates in cold storage until use.

steps.title: Transfer reagent to wells
steps.instruction: Using the appropriate pipette, aspirate the reagent from the reservoir and dispense the correct volume into each well of every loaded plate (80 µL per well with the P300 for buffer, or 7.6 µL per well with the P20 for mastermix).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the reagent from the reservoir with the selected pipette.
Dispense the specified volume into each well of all plates on the deck.
